name: Dundalk Leisurecraft MiniPOD Sauna Canadian Timber 2-4 Person | CTC77MW
description: Description The CT MiniPOD Sauna is a 7'x7' Sauna with side wall benches to seat up to 4 people sitting up or 2 people laying down. It is handcrafted in Canada with Eastern White Cedar lumber that is 1.5" thick and select tight knot grade. The door features a large tempered glass window and the outside walls are protected against the weather with black asphalt shingles. This easy-to-assemble kit is available with a wood burning or an electric sauna heater. Features Seats: 2-4 people Size: 7'x7'x7' (~210 cu ft) Wood: Eastern White Cedar Walls: 1.5" thick solid Cedar Door: Full-Sized Door with Bronze-Tempered Window for Easy Access Made in: Canada Weight : 1403 lbs Dimensions Includes Includes: Full sauna kit: Pre-cut tongue & groove white cedar for full sauna structure 2x Solid benches Ice & water shield Shingles Door w/ bronze tempered glass window Flat floor Hardware Installation guide & video Heater sold separately Choose a matched heater package in the heater options on this page, or contact us if you'd like a different heater. Sauna Accessories Add a Cold Plunge Tub , Outdoor Shower , Backrests , Bucket & Ladle , Lights , Thermometer , and Sand Timer to create the ultimate relaxation haven. Assembly
